notes: Three east-west avenues carry no name inside or near this strip and are recorded as '?': (1) the 60 ft avenue ending at Fergus Street at y 803 (only the word AVENUE is printed, x 7050-7180); (2) the 60 ft avenue through y 3640-3810 (Beech Hill, Fergus, Chambers, Dane; only AVENUE printed at x 8350-8550; probably Pullan Avenue, not read); (3) the 60 ft avenue through y 5130-5300 (Fergus, Mad Anthony, Chambers, Dane; only AVENUE printed at x 8640-8800; probably Chase Avenue, not read). In (3) the plate is trimmed along the south side west of Chambers; centre taken 45 px south of the north edge; a 10 in. water pipe line runs just south of centre. The street running east from Chambers Street across Dane Street (y 4214 to 4110) is the continuation of Apjones Street; east of Chambers only 'ST.' (60 ft) is printed, so the Apjones name there is assumed. Fergus Street is in two parts: a 30 ft part from Craven Avenue to y 1040, and a 50 ft part from Rodney Street (corner, recorded as T) south. Rodney Street/Fergus Street is an L corner. Dane Street/Crawford Street: Dane ends at Crawford beside the railroad; Crawford (40 ft, green boundary band along it) is hard to tell from the railroad lines. The west stub of Knowlton Street at Dane Street is cut by the plate edge. Dicks Alley (20 ft, printed ALLEY / DICKS) runs from the Apjones continuation to Ellis Street. Unnamed 13 ft alley south of Ellis Street at x about 9232 not recorded. B. & O. railroad crosses Dane Street near (9110,5500) and Chambers Street near (8540,5800): not streets. | Names read from labels outside the strip where the strip shows only AVE./AVENUE: Craven (label near x 6700, y 55), Frederick (label near x 3100, y 1085, same avenue followed east), Pullan (label near x 4150, y 4420, followed east), Beech Hill, Bruce. Chase Avenue: no name label found on the bottom avenue within the plate; named from the plate description, so treat the name as unconfirmed. Crawford: only the word CRAWFORD is printed (no suffix seen) along the green-banded strip beside the railroad; suffix Avenue is assumed. The Dane/Crawford point is where the 40 ft north-east leg of Dane meets that strip; it is uncertain whether this is a junction or simply Dane becoming Crawford. The street east of Dane in line with Apjones prints only ST. within reach; recorded as Apjones Street. Chase Avenue east of Dane continues as an unnamed street (6 in. W. pipe), recorded as part of the Chase/Dane cross. Fergus is offset: 30 ft piece at x 7452 from Craven to y 1040, 50 ft piece at x 7510 from Rodney south. Unnamed 13 ft alley south of Ellis near x 9230 (offset from Dicks Alley) not recorded. Double lines inside Dane and dashed lines are pipes/sewers.
